title: Google Workspace License Assigned Seats Leaderboard
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=googleworkspace:license assigned_seats=*
| stats sum(assigned_seats) as total_value, avg(assigned_seats) as avg_value by sku_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks SKU name values by total and average assigned seats across Google Workspace license events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `assigned_seats` values for each Google Workspace license event and review total and average assigned seats by SKU name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total assigned seats.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which SKU name shows the biggest assigned seats numbers in your Google Workspace license data.
